pages.title: Gold Singularity
pages.text: An immense hoard of gold, collapsed into one gleaming point. The warmth of the metal survives, and it gives off a soft yellow glow. Every ounce of it was originally forged in neutron star collisions, and now it is all in one place again.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Gold came from neutron star mergers, so it seemed fitting to crush it back down. The Singularity Compactor squeezed a pile of ingots into a single bright point.
